info.title: S-3 IOT Physical Bench & PyTorch Intelligence API
info.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and ChatGPT Action Interface for the S-3 IOT Energy Monitoring System. Monitors real ESP32 ADC bench hardware (DC LED Fixture & 5V DC Water Pump Motor) with zero-bias noise removal and PyTorch Neural Network state inference.

get.description: Returns calibrated live voltages, currents, power, and energy readings from the ESP32 for the DC LED and 5V DC Water Pump Motor. Sensor zero-point noise (~1.18V, ~0.2A) is automatically clamped when loads are OFF.

get.summary: Calculate active power, energy units, and 30-day bill projection
get.description: Calculates active power in Watts, cumulative kWh energy consumption, and projected monthly bill in Indian Rupees (₹8.00 per unit).

post.description: Feeds voltage and current telemetry into the trained PyTorch S3ElectricalTransformer model to classify electrical state (IDLE_OFF, LED_ACTIVE, PUMP_NORMAL, PUMP_STARTUP_INRUSH, PUMP_STALL_OVERLOAD, SENSOR_BIAS_ANOMALY).

200.description: PyTorch model prediction and zero-bias rectification result

get.description: Returns current thresholds for eliminating off-time phantom voltage (1.18V) and current (0.2A) drift.

get.summary: Get ESP32 GPIO pinout and sensor mapping
get.description: Returns GPIO pin assignments for ACS712 current sensors and resistor voltage dividers on ESP32 ADC1.
